conclusion.cause: After test-gate finishes, scripts/review.mjs writes its ~4.1 MB buffered output in one process.stdout.write. Tollgate's log consumer drains the pipe at ~64-97 KiB/s in 8192-byte frames, so the producer stays alive, blocked and idle, for 42-65 s; the native step ends 0.02-0.11 s after the last frame. About 97% of those bytes are passing-test console JSON from src/logging.ts.
notCause: producer computation (0.01 s CPU over the drain)
step settlement after the last frame
conclusion.unresolved: Why the Tollgate consumer path reads at ~68 KiB/s while not CPU bound (timer cadence, IPC or persistence) is not observable read-only.

repairBead.tollgateSide: Consumer throughput is a Tollgate observation, not a run-blocking defect under D16.
